Install RAM ERP on Android

Open this website in Chrome on your Android phone.

  1. Tap the Chrome menu ⋮.
  2. Choose Add to Home screen or Install app.
  3. Confirm installation and open RAM ERP from your home screen.

This is an installable web app, not an APK. Sign in with your workspace password on every device. An internet connection is required for shared data and saving.
